name: Bubble Spiral
description: A marble-chain arcade puzzle: a spiral of coloured marbles crawls toward a hole, and every shot you fire joins the chain. Connect three or more of a colour to pop them, and watch the gap snap shut — a closing seam can trigger a second match before the chain reaches the hole. One hundred seeded Journey boards across eight chapters, plus Classic, Endless, Zen and a shared daily spiral.
highlights: 100 seeded Journey spirals across eight chapters, each checked against a shot-budget fairness rule
Rainbow, bomb and frozen marbles, plus Slow, Reverse and Rainbow power-ups
Gap-closing chain reactions that can pop a second group
Daily challenge, endless waves, classic stages and a forgiving Zen mode
howToPlay: Aim with the pointer or by dragging, then release to fire.
Join three or more of the same colour to pop them.
Shoot a frozen marble once to thaw it before it can join a group.
levels: 100 Journey boards · 8 chapters + daily, endless, classic and Zen
